main_block: [IMF-024 | Dead Bug] 3 sets of 8 reps per side, rest 60 seconds between sets. Move slowly and keep your lower back flat on the floor the entire time.
[IMF-026 | Pallof Press] 3 sets of 10 reps per side, rest 60 seconds between sets. Stand tall and press straight out, resisting the cable pulling you sideways.
[IMF-046 | Heel Taps] 3 sets of 12 reps per side, rest 60 seconds between sets. Keep your lower back pressed into the floor throughout.
[IMF-028 | Plank, Forearms] 3 sets of 20 seconds, rest 60 seconds between sets. Focus on keeping your body in one straight line without letting your hips sag or rise.
[IMF-022 | Elliptical, Easy Pace] 18 minutes at a comfortable, conversational pace. This is steady and low-impact, which keeps things easy on the knees while still building your endurance.
